name: Purifying Fire
description: A ritual fire that searches a person's soul and purifies fire magic.

description_citations.text: "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra walks into the Purifying Fire, finds it has nothing to purify, and emerges unharmed and stronger.
timeline.quote: it finds nothing to purify and leaves Chandra not only unharmed but greatly bolstered in strength

citation.text: "The Purifying Fire", section "Plot summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra enters the Purifying Fire with a clean soul; it accepts her and she destroys the Order's forces, burning Walbert to death.
timeline.quote: burning Walbert and many others to death and cracking the very foundations of the cavern

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "The Purifying Fire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
